'''Viano Thag''' was a [[human]] who worked as a [[starship]] [[Technician|mechanic]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Based out of [[Point Ueda]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[planet]] [[Ueda]], he delved deep into [[thruster coil]]s and [[reactor tub]]s so that he could prove his skills.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Thag was working on a pile of parts just inside the city's gates when the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] passed through the gateway into Point Ueda.<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> 

While working, Thag wore a [[Color|tan]] [[Clothing|shirt]] and pants with a brown sleeveless [[jacket]], a brown apron, and gray [[boot]]s. He also wore a metallic gray facemask and yellow [[armored grappler glove]]s and used a [[durasteel]] [[dead blow hammer]]. He had light skin and brown [[hair]], including a beard.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Viano Thag first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Prior to the release of the episode, Thag was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]<ref name="Celebration">{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}}</ref> during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].<ref name="CelebrationDate">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}}</ref> The Ueda gate scene was shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> Thag was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
